name: BMW F750GS / F850GS
engine: 853 cc liquid-cooled parallel twin, fuel injected
intro: BMW's middleweight parallel-twin GS. Some 2020 bikes are in a brake light recall.

A-002.title: Check for open recalls
A-002.instructions: Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls. Some 2020 F750GS and F850GS bikes are in recall 20V146 (brake light flashes under hard braking).

recalls.what: Emergency stop signal can make the brake light flash instead of staying on.
recalls.fix: Dealer reprograms the emergency stop signal free.
